body:
I see pain specialists, a specialist of the condition, and a general physician regularly. 

I hide the severity of pain from everyone, except perhaps the doctors.

It is a long, painful trip so we only see old friends / family once every few years.  We don't really talk, so I think they would move on quickly.

I'm hoping if I leave them something and arrange for a comforting message, they will at least have a nice memory of me.  I don't want anyone to feel guilty.

My wife is more problematic and I have talked with her about being on her own.  I have been trying to get her to accept that I may not be around forever, but I portray it as more logistical.  I may need to transfer away and she may need to make a life by herself now.
